[[File:Rhoder.png|thumb|250px|Rhoder]] '''Rhoder''' (Japanese: '''ローダー''' ''Rhoder'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW117|Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!]]''. Sometime after [[Colress]] took control of Rhoder's {{p|Haxorus}}, Rhoder ran to where Haxorus was and tried convincing it to stop by explaining that it was destroying the city. Unfortunately, this did not shake Haxorus from Colress's machinations, and it continued its destructive purposes. Rhoder bumped into {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, and introduced himself as Haxorus's Trainer. He explained that Haxorus was normally calm and friendly. Ever since then, it would not listen to Rhoder. {{an|Iris}} tried resolving the situation by having {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}} use {{m|Ice Beam}} but was unsuccessful and Dragonite too became controlled by Colress. Rhoder watched on as his Haxorus and Iris's Dragonite were destroying the city. After a {{m|Shadow Ball}} coming from [[Aldith]]'s {{p|Liepard}} went astray, Haxorus reverted back to its normal docility and Rhoder recalled it back into its {{i|Poké Ball}}. Suddenly, a fog appeared, surrounding Ash and his friends, and Rhoder walked off, surprised that the group disappeared. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rhoder |pkmn=Haxorus |type1=Dragon |img=Rhoder Haxorus.png |epnum=BW117 |epname=Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation! |desc={{p|Haxorus}} first appeared possessed by [[Colress]]'s machines and was on a rampage in a city. Rhoder arrived and explained to the group that the Haxorus was his. Prior to the rampage, Rhoder explained that Haxorus was calm and friendly. Due to its destructive state, Haxorus did not listen to a word Rhoder said. {{an|Iris}} tried battling it with her {{TP|Iris|Dragonite}}, but Dragonite became possessed by Colress's machines in result. With both Pokémon possessed, Haxorus took on [[Cilan's Crustle]] while Dragonite battled with {{AP|Charizard}}. After one of the machines was destroyed by [[Aldith]]'s {{p|Liepard}}'s {{m|Shadow Ball}}, Haxorus went back to normal and was reunited with its Trainer.
